headline: Agricultural Extension Worker
summary: Community development organiser of five years who moved into agricultural extension in Misamis Occidental. I now train rice and corn farmers on conservation practices, pest management and composting, using the community organising skills that got farmers to trust our programs. I work best in the field.

experience.title: Agricultural Extension Worker
bullets: Run farmer field schools on rice and corn for about 120 farmers in five barangays.
Teach pest scouting and safer pest control, cutting pesticide spending on demo farms.
Set up composting of rice straw and corn stalks with farmer groups.

experience.title: Community Development Organizer
bullets: Organised fisherfolk and farmer associations and helped them register.
Facilitated planning workshops and trainings with community leaders.
Visited families to understand their needs and linked them to programs.

education.credential: Bachelor of Arts in Development Communication
